useCases.title: Auditd Rule Violation Detection
useCases.value: Auditd violations provide forensic evidence of security incidents and unauthorized system access.

useCases.title: Process Creation with Command Line Auditing
useCases.value: Full command-line visibility on process creation is the foundation of threat detection. Reveals encoded PowerShell, LOLBin abuse, and suspicious child processes.

useCases.title: Automatic Recording Events for High-Risk AI (Art. 12)
useCases.value: Demonstrates automatic recording of operation events for high-risk AI systems under Art. 12(1), including retention-ready correlation of model_id, decision_id, and subject_reference hash.

useCases.title: Model Input/Output Logging Integrity (Art. 12)
useCases.value: Verifies that each inference event carries paired input feature hash and output label/probability for Art. 12 traceability and post-incident reconstruction.

useCases.title: Automated Decision Audit Trail Reconstruction (Art. 12)
useCases.value: Chains decision_id across orchestrator, model gateway, and business rules engine to evidence end-to-end decision audit trail required for high-risk ADM logging.

useCases.title: Model Performance Degradation Detection (Art. 12)
useCases.value: Detects sudden drops in accuracy/auroc vs baseline to support operational logging and risk management for high-risk AI performance stability.

useCases.title: Bias Drift Monitoring Across Protected Attributes (Art. 12)
useCases.value: Tracks disparate impact ratio across demographic buckets over sliding windows to evidence ongoing bias monitoring aligned with Art. 12 and Annex IV risk management.

useCases.title: Transparency — Explainability Payload Presence (Art. 13)
useCases.value: Confirms user-facing responses include required explanation fields (summary, confidence, limitations) for transparency obligations under Art. 13.

useCases.title: Model Version Tracking and Immutable Version IDs (Art. 13)
useCases.value: Detects production traffic served from non-semver or missing model_version to support traceability and change control evidence.

useCases.title: Training Data Lineage Event Completeness (Art. 13)
useCases.value: Validates dataset_id, snapshot_hash, and license_tag on each training run completion for dataset lineage traceability.

useCases.title: Feature Importance Audit Snapshot Correlation (Art. 13)
useCases.value: Correlates SHAP export job completion with model_version to retain feature importance audit snapshots for transparency reviews.

useCases.title: Algorithm Change Documentation Linkage (Art. 13)
useCases.value: Ensures each production model_version has linked change_ticket and approver for algorithm change documentation.

useCases.title: Human Override Action Logging Coverage (Art. 14)
useCases.value: Measures fraction of automated decisions overridden by human operators with mandatory reason codes for Art. 14 human oversight.

useCases.title: Escalation to Human Review Queue Latency (Art. 14)
useCases.value: Tracks SLA from model_low_confidence event to human_assigned for timely human review per oversight procedures.

useCases.title: Autonomous Decision Threshold Breach Monitoring (Art. 14)
useCases.value: Alerts when decisions are auto-approved above configured risk_score without human gate, evidencing threshold enforcement.

useCases.title: Human-in-the-Loop Intervention Effectiveness (Art. 14)
useCases.value: Compares downstream outcomes after override vs baseline auto path to evidence intervention effectiveness for governance reviews.

useCases.title: Operator Session Segregation for High-Risk AI Consoles (Art. 14)
useCases.value: Detects concurrent high-risk console sessions per operator_id to support segregation of duties and oversight controls.

useCases.title: Quality Management System Control Evidence Freshness (Art. 17)
useCases.value: Monitors last_review date for each QMS control_id to ensure Art. 17 quality management system remains current.

useCases.title: Technical Documentation Completeness Checklist (Art. 11/Annex IV)
useCases.value: Scores required documentation sections present per model_id for Annex IV technical documentation completeness.

useCases.title: EU Database Registration Event Audit (Art. 49)
useCases.value: Tracks registration_id, status, and error codes from EU database API client logs for conformity registration evidence.

useCases.title: CE Marking Evidence — Test Report Coverage (Art. 48)
useCases.value: Joins product_sku to test_report_id coverage from test lab feeds for CE marking evidentiary chain.

useCases.title: Risk Management System — Hazard Log Update SLA (Art. 9/Annex IV)
useCases.value: Measures time from new_hazard to hazard_reviewed in risk register stream for RMS operational effectiveness.

useCases.value: Uses z-score on daily serious_complaint signals per model_id for early post-market surveillance escalation.

useCases.title: Serious Incident Report Pack Timeliness (Art. 73)
useCases.value: Tracks time from serious_incident_detected to regulator_packet_submitted for serious incident reporting workflows.

useCases.value: Verifies recall_command acknowledged by each edge node within SLA for model withdrawal evidence.

useCases.title: User Feedback Collection Pipeline Health (Art. 72)
useCases.value: Monitors volume and error rate of in-app feedback submissions for post-market user feedback collection integrity.

useCases.value: Confirms secure notification channel message_id acknowledged by authority mailbox/API within policy window.
